title: Marian
description: Marian web APM (Tempo span metrics), its Discord job queue (OTLP metrics pushed to Prometheus once a minute), and its warning/error logs.

panels.title: Requests / min
panels.description: HTTP requests per minute (server spans from Tempo span metrics), 5m average. Health checks and static files aren't traced.

panels.title: 5xx
panels.description: Share of requests in the last 15m answered with a 5xx status.

targets.expr: (sum (increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="marian", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"$route", http_status_code=~"5.."}[15m])) or sum (increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="marian", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"$route"}[15m])) * 0) / sum (increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="marian", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"$route"}[15m]))

panels.title: 4xx
panels.description: Share of requests in the last 15m answered with a 4xx status. Includes logged-out visitors and bots.

targets.expr: (sum (increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="marian", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"$route", http_status_code=~"4.."}[15m])) or sum (increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="marian", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"$route"}[15m])) * 0) / sum (increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="marian", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"$route"}[15m]))

panels.title: p50 latency
panels.description: Median request duration over 15m.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile request duration over 15m.

panels.title: Unmatched / min
panels.description: Requests to paths no route matches (span "GET unmatched"), mostly bots and scanners. Not in the other web panels unless picked under Route.

panels.title: Requests by status
panels.description: Requests per minute by HTTP status class.

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: Request duration percentiles over 5m windows (Tempo span-metric buckets).

panels.title: Busiest routes
panels.description: Requests per minute for the 10 busiest routes in the time range.

targets.expr: sum by (span_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="marian", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"$route"}[5m])) * 60 and on (span_name) topk(10, sum by (span_name) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="marian", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"$route"}[$__range] @ end())))

panels.title: Slowest routes (p95)
panels.description: p95 duration over 15m windows for the 10 routes with the highest p95 across the time range.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (span_name, le) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service="marian", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"$route"}[15m]))) and on (span_name) topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (span_name, le) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service="marian", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"$route"}[$__range] @ end()))))

panels.title: Routes
panels.description: Every route over the selected time range. Click a route to open its traces in Tempo.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (span_name, le) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service="marian", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"$route"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (span_name, le) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service="marian", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"$route"}[$__range])))

(sum by (span_name) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="marian", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"$route", http_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or sum by (span_name) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="marian", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"$route"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (span_name) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="marian", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"$route"}[$__range]))

(sum by (span_name) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="marian", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"$route", http_status_code=~"4.."}[$__range])) or sum by (span_name) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="marian", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"$route"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (span_name) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="marian", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"$route"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Jobs / min
panels.description: Discord job runs per minute (all outcomes), 5m average.

panels.title: Dropped in range
panels.description: Jobs that ran out of tries (9 runs) in the selected time range. Each one is also logged as an error. Should be 0.

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Share of runs in the last 15m that failed and will be tried again. Spikes during Discord outages or rate limits are normal; a steady share is not.

panels.title: p95 duration
panels.description: 95th percentile of job duration over 15m, rate-limit waits included.

panels.title: Backlog
panels.description: Jobs waiting in the queue plus failed jobs in their 2s pause. Should hover at 0.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: service.version of the process exporting metrics (from target_info).

panels.title: Runs by kind
panels.description: Job runs per minute, stacked by kind.

panels.title: Runs by outcome
panels.description: done = succeeded, failed = will be tried again in 2s (up to 8 times), dropped = out of tries.

panels.title: Failures and drops by kind
panels.description: Failed and dropped runs per 5m, by kind and outcome. Empty is good.

panels.title: p50 / p95 / p99 (all kinds)
panels.description: Job duration percentiles over 5m windows, rate-limit waits included.

panels.title: p95 by kind
panels.description: 95th percentile duration per job kind over 15m windows.

panels.title: Average duration by kind
panels.description: Mean run time per kind (sum / count) over 15m windows. Unlike percentiles, this does not depend on the bucket layout.

panels.title: Queue backlog
panels.description: waiting = jobs left in the queue when the last one was taken; retrying = failed jobs in their 2s pause. Together, the whole backlog. Reported once a minute.

panels.title: Warnings and errors
panels.description: marian log lines at WARN or ERROR, e.g. "Discord job failed, trying again" and "Discord job dropped after its last try".
